description: Telegram delivery channel for M146 de-duplicated dashboard alerts. Delivery only occurs for emitted alert events, so unchanged conditions do not produce repeat Telegram messages.
delivery_rules: send Telegram only when M146 emits one or more alert events
batch all alert events from one dashboard tick into one Telegram message
do not send anything for repeated unchanged conditions
log skipped_missing_credentials when token or chat id is unavailable
log dry_run_not_sent when dry-run mode is enabled
never include the bot token in JSON outputs or Markdown summaries
